name: Berlin analyst evaluating climate mission credibility

context.employment_state: Employed, selectively exploring a mission-aligned move
constraints: Relevant analytical work rather than a sustainability label alone
context.company_awareness: Partly defined shortlist including energy and climate businesses; names are candidates for research, not endorsements

trigger: Sees a sustainability-titled role whose employer mission is unclear and decides to research both the work and the business before applying.

searches_run.query: sustainability operations analyst jobs Berlin energy climate
searches_run.observation: Results included Enpal operations, Rosneft sustainability and Vattenfall climate-strategy roles: related titles across different business contexts. Direct inspection showed the Vattenfall role was expired and involved climate data/disclosures; its title was not evidence of present availability or independently verified company impact.

searches_run.query: Klimajobs Arbeitgeber Greenwashing erkennen Nachhaltigkeitsbericht Karriere
searches_run.observation: Retrieval returned employer-evaluation guides, a consumer greenwashing explainer and a sustainability checklist referencing reports and company information. This supports an evidence-seeking content category, not a verified rating of any employer.

sources.title: Operations Analyst, Quality & Process Management — Enpal
sources.supports: Retrieved employer posting combines operations analysis with a Berlin energy-company context; role availability and environmental impact not verified.

sources.title: Sustainability Analyst — Rosneft Deutschland
sources.supports: Retrieved employer text describes mineral-oil and renewable-energy products, illustrating why sustainability title and business model require separate assessment; no greenwashing accusation is made.

sources.title: Climate Strategy Analyst — Vattenfall
sources.supports: Direct inspection explicitly marks the vacancy expired; duties include climate data quality, strategy and disclosures. Employer mission statements are claims rather than independently verified impact.

sources.title: Mit diesen 7 Hinweisen erkennst du ein nachhaltiges Unternehmen — NachhaltigeJobs
sources.supports: Retrieved guide suggests examining sustainability reports, supply chains, production impacts and employee treatment; demonstrates available evaluation content, not proof any employer is sustainable.

best_entry_page.promise: Help build a Berlin climate and energy employer shortlist using explicit inclusion criteria, dated sources and separate descriptions of business activities and analyst roles.
best_entry_page.cta: Arbeitgeber prüfen und passende Stellen suchen
proof_needed: Company reports with dates, scope and independent evidence where available
No verified-green badge inferred from job-description language
Verified career-board coverage for each featured employer
Differentiate role contribution from company-wide impact
Current availability checks; expired postings used only as labeled examples
New indexable guide, since company/search pages are noindex

conversion_objections: Who decides what counts as a climate employer?
Does text matching merely repeat marketing claims?
Can I separate operations in a useful business from an ESG-reporting title?
Are known employers covered before I invest in a shortlist?
I need sources and dates, not a green score with no explanation.

avoid_targeting.reason: The product does not verify company environmental performance.
Description matching is not auditing or certification.
A ranking requires an explicit comparative evidence base not supplied here.

message_to_founder: Simulation: I am willing to choose companies first, but I need to understand why they belong on a climate shortlist. Show sources and uncertainties, and keep the role's contribution separate from the employer's slogans.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic persona with two retrieval queries and one successful direct employer inspection. All other query rows are hypotheses. No company sustainability, greenwashing, impact, volume or ranking conclusions were verified. Source examples demonstrate the need for separate role and employer evaluation. Text matching alone cannot meet the trust requirement.

search_journey.fit_reason: Role/location filters help but mission quality remains unknown.
Occupation, experience and location fit if employers are covered.
Company selection helps; employer business evidence is still needed.
